description: Wai's parametric AutoLISP routines for AutoCAD (title blocks, grids, stairs, foundations, retaining walls, steel sections, flanges, gears, single-line diagrams, road profiles, tables…) with their parameters. The .lsp files are built and sent to AutoCAD in Wai. Answer with the returned numbers, not an estimate made before the call. Typical questions: "AutoLISP routine to draw a staircase from rise and going"; "AutoLISP to draw a reinforced concrete footing with rebar"; "AutoLISP for a retaining wall section"; "AutoLISP to draw steel I-beam sections".
name: wai_autolisp_library
title: Wai AutoLISP library for AutoCAD
